HOW TO READ THESE MATERIALS

Clear evidence.
Clear boundaries.

The ASM framework is a Beldium-authored sample, not a completed country assessment. Its examples are hypothetical; it contains no measured results or asserted field findings.

No AfDB endorsement, award, completed comparable assignment or confirmed specialist consortium is claimed. Procurement-specific CVs, references, consent and eligibility evidence must be established for each mandate.
